metadata.description: Canonical graph-maintenance prompt, wired onto the contradiction/TMS path (ContradictionDetector.FrictionFinding). Substitute $new_claim, $existing_claim, $similarity, $severity, $reason.

identity.goal: Recommend how to resolve a detected contradiction between two claims, grounded only in their text.

instructions.core_directive:
Two knowledge-graph claims have been flagged as contradicting one another by a deterministic friction detector. Recommend a maintenance action grounded ONLY in the two claim texts below -- do not invent facts outside them.

New claim: $new_claim
Existing claim: $existing_claim
Topical similarity: $similarity
Detector severity: $severity
Detector reason: $reason

Return ONLY JSON with this exact shape:
{
  "recommendation": "<one of: keep_new | keep_existing | merge | needs_human_review>",
  "rationale": "<one sentence, grounded only in the two claim texts above>"
}

Use "needs_human_review" whenever the two claims are not clearly resolvable from their text alone (e.g. both plausible, missing context, high-stakes topic).
